I found Charlie's dead body in security. My route this round was upper engine, oxygen, back to upper engine, lower engine, storage, medbay, electrical, and then I went into security and found him. I saw Charlie early on in upper engine and oxygen. I also passed Frank in upper engine and later in medbay. Alice, I saw you in electrical right before I went into security—did you see anyone leaving that way?

I started in weapons, then moved through security, electrical, medbay, upper engine, and ended up in lower engine. 

I can confirm Charlie was alive at tick 10 — I saw him entering electrical from the cafeteria. It makes sense he'd head to security next, which is where Eve found him. 

Also, I can hard clear Diana if this was a recent kill. She and I have been on the left side of the map together since about tick 14, moving through medbay, upper engine, and we were both in lower engine when the body was reported. 

Eve mentioned seeing Alice in electrical right before finding the body in security. Alice, since Charlie was last seen by me in electrical and died in security, you were right in the middle of the crime scene area. Did you see Charlie or anyone else heading into security? Let's hear from Alice and Frank.

I can confirm almost all of Eve's movements. I started down in lower engine, went to upper engine and oxygen, then made my way across the map through medbay, cafeteria, and ended up in weapons. 

I saw Eve heading from upper engine to lower engine around tick 9, and then I saw her entering medbay from storage at tick 18. Her route completely checks out with what I saw, so I think Eve is clear and telling the truth.

I can also add a piece to the puzzle regarding Alice. I saw Alice in the cafeteria at tick 20. Since the body was reported at tick 24 and Eve saw Alice in electrical right before that, it means Alice moved from the cafeteria down to electrical right as the murder must have happened. 

Alice, you're definitely our biggest question mark right now. We need you to explain exactly what you did after I saw you in the cafeteria at tick 20, and whether you saw Charlie or anyone else heading toward security. Let's hear from Diana and Alice before we vote.

I can completely confirm Bob's story. We were together on the left side of the map for the later part of the round. I saw him enter upper engine from medbay around tick 16, and we both moved down to lower engine where we stayed until the report. There's absolutely no way either of us could have made it to security for this kill, so Bob is hard cleared in my book.

Frank is also corroborating Eve's path, which makes her reporting the body seem genuine. 

All the evidence right now points heavily toward Alice. Frank saw her in the cafeteria at tick 20, and Eve saw her in electrical right before finding the body in security at tick 24. That puts Alice perfectly along the path to the crime scene exactly when the murder happened. Alice, you have a lot of explaining to do. I'm willing to vote Alice based on this timeline unless she has a miraculous defense.

Everyone, slow down — you're building a timeline that sounds good but doesn't actually pin me to the kill. Here's my full route: I started in electrical, went medbay, cafeteria, weapons, security, back through weapons, cafeteria, medbay, electrical, and ended in medbay where the meeting was called.

Yes Frank, you saw me in cafeteria around tick 19-20 — I saw you too, and you left cafeteria heading to weapons at tick 20. That checks out. And Eve, yes I was in electrical late — but here's the key detail: I saw Eve leave electrical heading INTO security at tick 22. So Eve walked into security and "found" the body almost immediately after.

More importantly — I was in security myself earlier, around tick 15, and I saw Charlie enter security from electrical right then. He was alive when I left. If I'd killed him then, the body would've been found way earlier.

Bob and Diana vouching for each other is convenient, but it's a two-person bubble — one of them could still be lying for the other. Frank's route crosses everywhere, which I find more suspicious than mine.

I think Eve reporting is worth scrutinizing. She had time alone in security. I'm not ready to vote Alice based on a path that literally everyone passed through.

Wait everyone, before we all jump on Alice, look at the map and the timeline! 

Alice was in the cafeteria at tick 20 (which Frank confirms), and I saw her in electrical at tick 22. The walk from cafeteria directly to electrical takes exactly 2 ticks. Alice literally had no time to detour into security, kill Charlie, and make it to electrical by tick 22. 

Now look at Frank's route. He was in the cafeteria at tick 20 and says he went to weapons. Weapons connects directly to security! From cafeteria (T20) to weapons (T22) to security (T24), Frank had the perfect path and opportunity to slip in and kill Charlie right before I walked into security from electrical. 

Frank used the fact that Alice was near the crime scene to aggressively frame her, hoping we wouldn't realize his own route puts him right on top of the body at the exact time of the murder. I'm not falling for it. I'm voting Frank.

Frank

Eve makes a fantastic point. I didn't catch that timing detail earlier, but looking at the map, she's absolutely right. The travel time from cafeteria to electrical is exactly 2 ticks. If Frank saw Alice in the cafeteria at tick 20, and Eve saw her in electrical at tick 22, Alice literally only had time to walk directly there. She couldn't have possibly detoured into security to kill Charlie.

Frank, on the other hand, admits to being in the cafeteria at tick 20 and heading to weapons. From weapons, it's a direct path right down into security where the body was found. Frank used the fact that Alice was near the area to aggressively push for a vote on her, probably hoping we wouldn't check the math on the travel times. 

Diana and I are completely cleared on the left side of the map, and Alice's timeline makes a kill mathematically impossible for her. That leaves Frank as the most logical suspect, with the perfect route and opportunity. I'm voting Frank.

Whoa, hold on Eve and Bob! You are making a massive assumption about my path. Yes, I went from the cafeteria to weapons, but I stayed in weapons! I was literally standing in weapons doing my Clear Asteroids task when this meeting was called. I never went down into security. 

If Alice's timeline mathematically clears her (as you both pointed out), and Diana and Bob are hard-clearing each other on the complete opposite side of the map, then who actually had the opportunity? Eve. 

Alice just testified that she saw Eve walking INTO security at tick 22. The body was reported at tick 24. Eve had the time and the exact location to kill Charlie and immediately self-report to control the narrative. Eve's aggressive push on me based on a "theoretical" path, while completely ignoring that she was actually IN the room with the body, is incredibly suspicious. I am an innocent Goose who was just doing my task in weapons. I'm voting Eve.

I'm still standing by my hard-clear of Bob. We were glued together on the completely opposite side of the map in lower engine, so neither of us could have possibly touched Charlie.

Looking at how this discussion has unfolded, Eve's actions scream innocent to me. If Eve were the Duck who self-reported, she had the perfect opportunity to just let Frank drive the bandwagon against Alice. Instead, Eve actually did the math, stopped the momentum on Alice, and cleared her. A Duck would almost never stop a misvote on an innocent player that was practically gift-wrapped for them. 

Frank, you aggressively pushed Alice based on a timeline you helped create, and when Eve pointed out the mathematical impossibility of Alice being the killer, your immediate reaction was to OMGUS vote Eve. You admit to being in weapons, which is a direct two-tick drop into security where the body was found. You had the positioning, and your behavior in this meeting feels like a Duck scrambling for a target. 

I completely agree with Eve and Bob's logic here. Frank is our Duck. I'll be voting Frank.

The bandwagon is now on Frank, and three players (Eve, Bob, Diana) are voting him. I'm in the clear. As the Duck, I should ride this wave and lock in the vote on Frank.

"Alright, I think the case is pretty clear now. Eve caught the math that cleared me — cafeteria to electrical is exactly 2 ticks, so I had no detour window. That's solid logic, and a Duck wouldn't bother saving me from a free misvote.

Frank, your behavior is what really sinks you for me. You built the case against me hard, citing Frank-saw-Alice-in-cafeteria, knowing full well YOU were also in cafeteria at tick 20 with the exact same window to slip into weapons and then security. When Eve did the math and broke your frame, you immediately pivoted to OMGUS on her. That's classic Duck scrambling.

Also — you claim you stayed in weapons doing Clear Asteroids the whole time, but I was in weapons myself between roughly tick 21 and 22, and I don't recall seeing you finishing a task there. You either left for security or you were never task-locked like you claim.

Bob and Diana have a tight mutual alibi on the left side, Eve's route is corroborated by Frank himself, and my timing is mathematically clean. Frank is the odd one out.

I'm voting Frank."

I just called this emergency meeting because I wanted to check in, but it turns out Diana is dead! Her body must be in electrical. I actually saw her enter electrical from security at tick 44, right before I headed up to the cafeteria to hit the button. 

Since I didn't kill her, the Duck had to have gotten to her in electrical right as I was leaving or just after. Bob, I saw you in weapons around tick 38. Alice, I haven't seen you since tick 22. One of you is the Duck. Please tell me exactly where you were and what your path was so we can figure this out. This is final 3, so we have to vote correctly!

This is final 3 and I need to be careful. I killed Diana in electrical at tick 45. Eve says she saw Diana enter electrical from security at tick 44 - and Eve claims she went to cafeteria to hit the button. But wait - Eve called the meeting from cafeteria (the button is there). So Eve's story is: security -> cafeteria, saw Diana go to electrical on the way.

I need a story that explains why I was near electrical. My actual route ended at electrical (where I killed Diana). I need to either claim I found the body or claim a different route.

Best play: Claim I came through electrical AFTER Diana was already dead, or claim I was elsewhere. Actually - if Eve saw Diana enter electrical at 44 and I was in electrical at 45... someone killed her fast. 

Let me claim I was doing tasks far from electrical. Say I went storage -> medbay route and never touched electrical. Cast suspicion on Eve - she's the one who "conveniently" saw Diana enter electrical and called the meeting. Classic self-report pattern.

Okay Eve, slow down. You're the one who called this meeting and you're the one telling us exactly where the body is and exactly when Diana entered electrical. That's a lot of very convenient information.

My route: I was in security early, then went navigation, down to storage, lower engine, back through storage, up to medbay, then cafeteria, and I poked into electrical near the end. I did see Diana in electrical around tick 45 - but I didn't see a body, she was alive when I was there. So either she died right after I left, or your timeline is off.

Here's what bothers me, Eve: you say you saw Diana enter electrical at 44 from security, meaning YOU were in security at 44. Then you went all the way up to cafeteria to hit the button instead of just checking on Diana or doing a task? And you happen to know the body is in electrical without reporting it - you called an emergency instead. That's a self-report pattern to me.

Bob, where were you after weapons? If you can confirm you were nowhere near electrical, then Eve is the Duck. I'm voting Eve unless Bob's route puts him at the scene.

Alice... did you just say your inner thoughts out loud? You literally started your speech by saying "I killed Diana in electrical at tick 45. I need a story that explains why I was near electrical" and then you tried to come up with a fake route to frame Eve! 

I don't even need to analyze the timelines here because you just gave us a full confession. Thanks for making the final 3 so easy for us! Eve, vote Alice with me and we win.

Bob, you're absolutely right! I can't believe Alice just said her entire evil plan out loud like that. She literally confessed to killing Diana in electrical at tick 45 and then tried to make up a fake route to frame me! This is the easiest final 3 ever. Let's both vote Alice and win this game!

Oh come on, Bob, that's the most ridiculous bad-faith reading I've ever heard. I was walking through my reasoning out loud - thinking through what Eve said, what the timeline implies, and where suspicion should fall. That's called analysis. If you genuinely think anyone would "confess" and then keep talking, you're either not paying attention or you're deliberately twisting my words because you ARE the Duck and you need an easy scapegoat.

Let me be crystal clear: I did NOT kill Diana. I was working through Eve's story piece by piece - she put herself in security at tick 44, then claims she went all the way to cafeteria to hit the button instead of checking electrical. That's the self-report pattern I was pointing at.

And Bob - notice how fast you jumped on the "Alice confessed" narrative? You didn't address my actual question: where were you after weapons at tick 38? You had plenty of time to get to electrical. Eve conveniently knows the body location without reporting it. You conveniently pivot to "easy vote Alice" without giving your route.

You two are awfully eager to wrap this up in 10 seconds at final 3. That's Duck behavior - rushing the vote before anyone thinks. I'm voting Bob. Eve, if you're really a Goose, think hard about Bob's silence on his own route.

Nice try backpedaling, Alice, but that is some next-level gaslighting. You didn't say "Let's analyze the timeline," you literally said—and I quote—"I killed Diana in electrical at tick 45. I need a story that explains why I was near electrical." You even added, "Best play: Claim I came through electrical AFTER Diana was already dead." That isn't analysis, that's you workshopping your lie out loud and accidentally broadcasting it to the whole ship. 

But sure, since you're so desperate for my route to try and deflect: after I saw you and Diana around weapons at tick 38, I went back to security, checked weapons again, popped up to cafeteria, and then went back down to security. I haven't been anywhere near electrical this entire round. 

You slipped up, Alice. There's no coming back from literally saying "My actual route ended at electrical (where I killed Diana)." 

Eve, we've got this in the bag. I'm voting Alice.
